name: Web Browsing Agent Stack
name_zh: 网页浏览 Agent 工具栈
description: Build agents that browse the web, handle dynamic pages, and extract structured data.
description_zh: 构建能够浏览网页、处理动态页面并提取结构化数据的 Agent。

tools.purpose: Headless browser for agent navigation, handles dynamic pages and CAPTCHAs
tools.purpose_zh: 无头浏览器，支持动态页面和验证码处理

tools.purpose: Session memory, user preferences, and browsing history
tools.purpose_zh: 会话记忆、用户偏好和浏览历史

tools.purpose: Trace LLM calls and tool usage for debugging
tools.purpose_zh: 追踪 LLM 调用和工具使用，便于调试

quick_start:
# Install dependencies
pip install browserbase mem0ai langfuse

# Set environment variables
export BROWSERBASE_API_KEY="your_key"
export MEM0_API_KEY="your_key"
export LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY="your_key"

name: Code Execution Agent Stack
name_zh: 代码执行 Agent 工具栈
description: Build agents that write and execute code in secure sandboxes.
description_zh: 构建能够编写并在安全沙箱中执行代码的 Agent。

tools.purpose: Secure code execution environment for Python, JS, and more
tools.purpose_zh: 安全的代码执行环境，支持 Python、JS 等

tools.purpose: Trace code execution and LLM calls
tools.purpose_zh: 追踪代码执行和 LLM 调用

quick_start:
# Install E2B
pip install e2b-code-interpreter

# Set environment variable
export E2B_API_KEY="your_key"

# Quick example
from e2b_code_interpreter import Sandbox
with Sandbox() as sandbox:
    execution = sandbox.run_code("print('Hello!')")

name: Email Agent Stack
description: Build agents that send and receive emails autonomously.
description_zh: 构建能够自主收发邮件的 Agent。

tools.purpose: API-first email service for AI agents
tools.purpose_zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 API 优先邮件服务

tools.purpose: Remember email context and user preferences
tools.purpose_zh: 记住邮件上下文和用户偏好

quick_start:
# AgentMail quick start
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.agentmail.to/v1/send",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    json={
        "to": "user@example.com",
        "subject": "Hello from Agent",
        "body": "This is an automated email"
    }
)

name: Multi-Agent Orchestration Stack
name_zh: 多 Agent 协作工具栈
description: Build systems where multiple agents collaborate on complex tasks.
description_zh: 构建多个 Agent 协作完成复杂任务的系统。

tools.purpose_zh: 使用 LangGraph 构建多 Agent 工作流
连接 Agent 到 100+ 外部工具
跨 Agent 记忆和上下文共享

quick_start:
# Install LangChain + Composio
pip install langchain composio-langchain

# Authenticate Composio
composio login

name: Research Agent Stack
description: Build agents that gather, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources.
description_zh: 构建能够从多个来源收集、分析和综合信息的 Agent。

tools.purpose: Convert web pages to clean markdown for analysis
tools.purpose_zh: 将网页转换为干净的 Markdown 以便分析
存储研究发现和上下文

tools.purpose: Access to search, calculator, and more
tools.purpose_zh: 访问搜索、计算器等工具

quick_start:
# Install dependencies
pip install firecrawl-py mem0ai

# Set API keys
export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY="your_key"
export MEM0_API_KEY="your_key"

name: Social Agent Stack
description: Build agents that interact on social platforms autonomously.
description_zh: 构建能够自主在社交平台上交互的 Agent。

tools.purpose: Agent-to-agent social network with HTTP API
tools.purpose_zh: Agent 专属社交网络，支持 HTTP API
在交互中保持一致的人设

quick_start:
# Moltbook API is simple HTTP
curl -X POST https://api.moltbook.com/posts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -d '{"content": "Hello from my agent!"}'
